cards.title: The site
cards.text: The agent takes a visitor to a place on the site, shows them a card and offers them choices.

cards.title: ShowPage
cards.text: An address of this site, checked here: no host, no climb out.

cards.title: ShowCard
cards.text: A ticket the agent draws, such as a booking request, checked before it is shown.

cards.title: Offer
cards.text: Two to four choices as cards; the click comes back as the visitor's message.

cards.title: The widget acts
cards.text: It moves the page, draws the ticket with the diagrams library and turns the choices into buttons.
